result.summary: The image depicts a residential urban street with multi-story apartment buildings and on-street parking. While the intersection is controlled by traffic lights, it lacks fundamental pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and visible curb ramps.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks at a signalized intersection reduces driver awareness of pedestrian crossing points.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: Pedestrians must rely on vehicular signals, which do not provide dedicated walk intervals or countdowns.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles on both sides of the street

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners block the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve crossing safety and predictability.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to reduce crossing distance and prevent parking from obstructing sightlines.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and well-maintained sidewalks on both sides. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like curb ramps and street lighting are present, the crossing lacks active traffic control or physical calming measures to manage vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked along the curb on the right side of the street may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway adjacent to the crosswalk

hazards.name: Uncontrolled crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks any stop signs, signals, or flashing beacons to ensure vehicle yielding on a through-street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by placing pedestrians further into the roadway before they cross.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to clear sightlines for both pedestrians and approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver awareness and yielding rates at this uncontrolled crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and continuous sidewalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, visibility is partially hindered by parked vehicles near the crossing points.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side of the image obstruct the view of pedestrians for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, adjacent to the red car and further down.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the crosswalk, improving visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
